name: [☢️] Build a Bunker!
desc:
☢️ Welcome to Build A Bunker!

Nukes hit the world every 5 minutes. Get loot from the town and use it to upgrade your bunker. Can you survive until help arrives?

[ How To Play ]
🍎 Grab food, 🔫 weapons, and 🪵 supplies
☢️ Get inside the bunker before the nuke
⚔️ Fight enemies and protect your bunker
🏗️ Build and upgrade your bunker
💀 Can you survive?

scripts.title: BUILD A BUNKER ULTIMATE MENU by SFY
scripts.features:
## 🎮 Main Features (Detailed — for website / product page)

* **Bring All Items** — Instantly pull every collectible item in range to your location for fast looting.
* **ESP Items** — Highlight & track items through walls with clean, unobtrusive overlays and distance readouts.
* **Fast Build Room** — Rapidly construct rooms and structures with one-click templates and snap-to-grid placement.
* **Speed Hack** — Smooth, adjustable movement speed with anti-stutter optimization.
* **Fly** — Free-flight mode with configurable altitude and smoothing for natural motion.
* **NoClip** — Pass through geometry seamlessly; toggleable and safe to use with instant on/off.
* **And more** — Additional conveniences and QoL tools included.
